jobs.title: Manager, Corporate Development
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. is a leading developer, publisher, and marketer of interactive entertainment for consumers around the globe. For more than 25 years, our development teams have created some of the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful entertainment experiences, captivating and engaging audiences around the world. We are incredibly proud of our ability to deliver consistently the highest-quality titles, as well as our colleagues who help to create our unique culture and work environment that is inclusive, diverse, and dynamic.

While our offices are casual and inviting, we are deeply committed to our core tenets of creativity, innovation and efficiency, and individual and team development opportunities. Our industry and business are continually evolving and fast-paced, providing numerous opportunities to learn and hone your skills. We work hard, but we also like to have fun, and believe that we provide a great place to come to work each day to pursue your passions.

The Challenge:

Take-Two Interactive is seeking a motivated Manager to join its highly visible Corporate Development & Strategy team. This is an exciting opportunity for a curious, business-minded individual with a demonstrated passion for video games and strong technical skills. In this role, you will work with senior management and the board of directors at the corporate level and with label leadership to drive M&A, investments, strategic initiatives, and the Company’s overall long-term strategy. You’ll be responsible for performing rigorous quantitative and qualitative analyses that drive key decisions across the organization. The ideal candidate is adept at financial modeling, skilled at translating complex data into clear, actionable insights, and has excellent communication skills for presenting findings to senior leadership.

What you'll take on:

•    Develop and refine financial models that will support the assessment and valuation of potential acquisitions, early to late stage investments, and strategic initiatives.
•    Monitor trends within the interactive entertainment industry to identify emerging opportunities.
•    Conduct in-depth research and analysis on industry competitors and market developments, delivering regular insights to the team.
•    Assist in due diligence efforts for M&A and partnership opportunities.
•    Assist with the preparation of clear, concise presentations, memoranda, and reports for senior management and Board meetings.
•    Assist with new initiatives driven by the Corporate Development group including, but not limited to, the creation of new business units, post-acquisition integration, and business model innovation.

What you bring:

•    2+ years of experience in Investment Banking, Private Equity, and/or Corporate Development.
•    Prior experience in the interactive entertainment industry is preferred.
•    Proficiency in building financial/operating models and a thorough understanding of valuation methodologies (DCF, Precedent Transactions, Public Trading Comparables, SOTP, etc.).
•    Advanced skills in Excel and PowerPoint.
•    Highly organized, proactive, and capable of managing multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment.
•    Exceptional analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
•    Ability to communicate in a highly effective manner both written & verbally.

What We Offer You:

- Great Company Culture . Ranked as one of the most creative and innovative places to work, creativity, innovation, efficiency, diversity and philanthropy are among the core tenets of our organization and are integral drivers of our continued success.

- Growth : As a global entertainment company, we pride ourselves on creating environments where employees are encouraged to be themselves, inquisitive, collaborative and to grow within and around the company.

- Work Hard, Play Hard. Our employees bond, blow-off steam, and flex some creative muscles – through corporate boot camp classes, company parties, game release events, monthly socials, and team challenges.

- Benefits . Medical (HSA & FSA), dental, vision, 401(k) with company match, employee stock purchase plan, commuter benefits, in-house wellness program, broad learning & development opportunities, a charitable giving platform with company match and more!

- Perks . Fitness allowance, employee discount programs, free games & events and stocked pantries.

Take-Two also does not engage in any financial exchanges during the recruitment or onboarding process, and the Company will never ask a candidate for their personal or financial information over an app or other unofficial chat channel. Any attempt to do so may be the result of a scam or phishing exercise. Headquartered in New York City, Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. is a leading developer, publisher, and marketer of interactive entertainment for consumers around the globe. We develop and publish products principally through Rockstar Games, 2K, and Zynga. Our strategy is to create hit entertainment experiences, delivered on every platform relevant to our audience through a variety of sound business models. Our pillars - creativity, innovation, and efficiency - guide us as we strive to create the highest quality, most captivating experiences for our consumers. The Company’s common stock is publicly traded on NASDAQ under the symbol TTWO. For more corporate and product information please visit our website at http://www.take2games.com .

The Challenge

The primary function of this role includes the day-to-day analysis and administration needs with respect to the Compensation function.

What You’ll Take On

- Prepare, analyze, and submit compensation data to external market survey providers, ensuring accuracy and alignment with survey requirements.

- Conduct job matching, market benchmarking, and compensation analysis to develop data-driven compensation recommendations for review and approval.

- Provide analytical and administrative support for salary structures, market pricing, compensation planning, and other compensation programs.

- Support the Compensation team in the delivery of the annual global compensation review process, including data preparation, analysis, and process coordination.

- Maintain compensation data within HR systems and support data integrity, reporting, and compensation processes through HR technology platforms.

- Prepare quarterly compensation reporting and perform ad hoc analyses to support business needs and provide meaningful insights.

- Manage the Compensation team inbox and respond to compensation-related queries from HR Business Partners.

- Support the development and delivery of compensation communications, training, and stakeholder education materials.

- Stay informed of compensation trends, market practices, and regulatory developments through industry research and professional resources.

- Support compensation projects, process improvements, and other team initiatives as required.

- 2–4 years of relevant compensation, HR, or analytical experience, preferably supporting global compensation programs within a multinational organization or global compensation consulting environment.

- Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or Finance, Master’s degree in HR would be preferred

- Working knowledge of compensation principles, including salary structures, market pricing, job matching, and annual compensation planning.

- Experience supporting compensation administration and compensation programs.

- Experience working with HRIS platforms (e.g., Workday) and compensation-related systems preferred.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and strong working knowledge of Microsoft Word and PowerPoint.

- Experience with reporting and data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI) is preferred.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret, analyze, and communicate complex data.

- Ability to present compensation insights and recommendations in a clear, concise, and meaningful format.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with HR Business partners, and global stakeholders.

- Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

- Ability to work independently, take initiative, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

- Proven ability to collaborate effectively within a team and build strong working relationships.

- This position requires 4 days in office and potential travel to two offices located locally.

In this role, you'll serve as the strategic partner to HR leadership teams across all three labels, helping translate enterprise HR strategy into actionable people programs, org design decisions, and operating plans. It's a rare opportunity to shape how a world-class people organization runs, from the inside.

- Serve as the primary strategic partner to the HR leadership teams across Zynga, 2K, and Take-Two, translating HR strategy into priorities, programs, and operating plans for the global HR function.

- Deliver people analytics and actionable insights that inform decision-making HR leaders, turning data into clear recommendations.

- Co-design and deliver HR programs in partnership with Centers of Expertise (Total Rewards, Talent, Learning, People Ops), sharing accountability for program quality and adoption across the function.

- Ensure compliance across HR policies and programs in partnership with Legal and Compliance, accounting for multi-jurisdictional employment law and data privacy requirements.

- Partner with Finance and the SVP of HR to align HR headcount, operating spend, and investments to budget, with shared accountability for financial outcomes.

- Coordinate cross-functional HR initiatives with Business HRBPs and People Ops, ensuring consistent execution, clear handoffs, and alignment across the broader organization.

What You Bring

- 8+ years of progressive HR Business Partner experience, including direct support of senior leadership (VP level and above) in a complex, matrixed organization.

- Demonstrated experience supporting an HR function as a client group, with an understanding of the unique dynamics of partnering with people professionals.

- Strong organizational design and workforce planning capabilities, with the ability to translate business strategy into structural and staffing recommendations.

- Track record leading talent management programs, including succession planning, leadership development, and performance calibration for senior and critical roles.

- Experience managing HR risk and employee relations escalations with sound judgment, discretion, and collaboration with Legal.

- Proficiency with people analytics, with the ability to synthesize data into clear, actionable insights for senior stakeholders.

- Change management expertise, including planning, stakeholder engagement, and adoption measurement for large-scale initiatives.

- Exceptional stakeholder influence skills, with comfort pushing back, building consensus, and navigating competing priorities across multiple leadership teams.

- Working knowledge of multi-jurisdictional employment law, particularly across North America (US and Canada required; additional geographies a plus).

- Commercial acumen and budget awareness, with experience partnering with Finance on headcount planning and operating spend.

Great to Have:

- Experience in the gaming, entertainment, or tech industry.

- Familiarity with HR tools and platforms used in enterprise-scale people operations (e.g., Workday).

- Coaching certification or formal leadership development training.

Senior HRBPs at Take-Two play a critical role in shaping performance, culture, and engagement by balancing business priorities with employee experience. The successful candidate will model Take-Two’s core values of kindness, teamwork, and excellence, and act as a trusted advisor across all levels of the organization.

What You’ll Take On

- Serve as a strategic HR partner to senior leaders up to EVP level, aligning people strategies with business objectives to drive performance, engagement, and organizational health.

- Provide strategic coaching and counsel to leaders and employees on performance management, development, engagement, workforce effectiveness, and employee relations, partnering closely with the Employee Relations and Legal team as needed.

- Lead and execute core HR programs across the employee lifecycle, including performance management, compensation planning, goal setting, talent reviews, succession planning, promotions, and engagement initiatives.

- Partner with leaders on organizational design, workforce planning, and change management, supporting business transformation and scalable growth.

- Analyze and interpret HR data and workforce metrics (e.g., headcount, attrition, turnover, job architecture, compensation) to generate insights and inform decision-making.

- Collaborate closely with HR Centers of Excellence (Talent Acquisition, Compensation, Talent Development, People Operations, Benefits, People Analytics, etc.) to deliver integrated, high-impact people solutions.

- Drive process improvement and operational excellence, ensuring HR programs are scalable, consistent, and aligned globally.

- Act as a trusted advisor with a strong pulse on employee sentiment, balancing agility and speed with sound HR practices and risk awareness.

- Manage multiple priorities across teams and geographies with professionalism, adaptability, and a strong focus on outcomes.

- Must be able to work onsite from our Austin office.

What You Bring

- Direct HR Business Partner experience, preferably within fast-growing, global technology, media, or entertainment companies.

- Demonstrated experience partnering across multi-location and/or global teams supporting tech and non-tech functions.

- Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

- HR professional certification (PHR, SPHR, SHRM-CP, or equivalent) preferred but not required.

- Strong business acumen with the ability to translate business needs into effective people strategies.

- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and partner across all levels of the organization.

- Proven ability to operate in fast-paced, high-growth environments with agility and sound judgment.

- Ability to work with both onsite and distributed remote teams effectively.

- Proactive, solution-oriented mindset with strong problem-solving skills.

- Ability to manage competing priorities and meet critical deadlines.

- Experience building, evolving, and scaling HR processes and programs.

- Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills; comfortable acting as a change agent.

- Solid project management capabilities.

- Experience using Workday and other HR systems and tools, along with Google Suite and Microsoft Office.

What We Offer You
